content:
Besides releasing the first public betas of iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate, Apple also simultaneously launched updated developer betas with new build numbers. Here are the details.

Updated versions released alongside the public beta

Alongside the first public beta, Apple also released updated versions of the third developer betas of iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate.

The updated third developer beta of iPadOS 27 carries build number 24A5380l, while the updated third beta of macOS 27 Golden Gate carries build number 26A5378n.

It is currently unclear why Apple has released updated versions, as no widespread serious issues were reported with the previous builds. The changes may have been made to address problems discovered before today's public beta release, but Apple has not provided any details.

However, we are examining the new versions closely and will report back if we find anything noteworthy.

Have you discovered anything new in the updated versions? Let us know in the comments section.
